articles.title: Welcome to the Fade desk: the front page of sports betting
articles.dek: Original reporting, verified bettors, celebrity case files, and the day's slate — written by the desk, read before you bet.
articles.author: Fade Desk
body: This is the Fade desk — the newsroom side of the app. Every day we publish what actually matters before the games start: where the numbers moved, who's betting what, and which records are real.

Wire headlines from around sports run alongside our own reporting, always credited and linked to the source. The original work — case files, verified bettor stories, and desk reports — lives here and in the app.
Want it on your phone? The full desk, with alerts when your friends and the biggest names in sports place a bet, is live in the Fade app.
